caption: The drawing features a long-sleeved, floor-length dress displayed on a plain beige background. The dress is primarily brown and is adorned with small, colorful floral patterns scattered across the garment; the flowers are yellow, purple, and green. Green and purple diagonal bands with a floral motif decorate the bodice, waist, and sleeve cuffs. The neckline is round and appears to have a light beige or white collar. There is no figure wearing the dress; it is illustrated as if laid flat or suspended. In the top right corner, there is a smaller, monochrome line sketch of the same dress showing the back view, including a sash or tie at the waist, without any floral details or color.
title: Dress
